mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t2.tasa_fund_cd AS tasaFundCd , F_JM_NM(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd) AS jmNm , t1.dang_gijun_ga AS dangGijunGa , t1.jun_gijun_ga AS junGijunGa , (NVL(t1.dang_gijun_ga, 0) - NVL(t1.jun_gijun_ga, 0)) AS gijunGaDr , t1.gyul_gijun_ga AS gyulGijunGa , t1.bf_siga_aek AS bfSigaAek , t1.load_siga_aek AS loadSigaAek , t1.bigo AS bigo , t1.dang_ggijun_ga AS dangGgijunGa , t1.gyul_ggijun_ga AS gyulGgijunGa FROM SJT0SC t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN sjm0sc t2 ON t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.tasa_jm_cd = t1.jm_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr LIKE #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = #{ymd} ORDER BY t1.corp_gr ASC, t1.jm_cd ASC
